verdicts.fact: The not_applicable classification emits W_PARAM_NOT_APPLICABLE.
verdicts.label: context
verdicts.rationale: "`not_applicable` carries NO live-owner obligation (C4c is scoped with a literal backticked `ignored`) and emits Warning-severity W_PARAM_NOT_APPLICABLE rather than Error-severity E_PARAM_NOT_HONORED, so it is the cheapest-looking exit from a gate failure"

verdicts.fact: The not_applicable disposition carries no live-owner obligation and must not be misused to evade ownership of unimplemented meaningful parameters.
verdicts.label: holding
verdicts.rationale: "Do not reach for `not_applicable` to escape an owner obligation — that is the specific abuse this ruling forecloses." ...
